## Intent

Describe the user-visible behavior, domain invariant or engineering evidence improved by this PR.

## Verification

- [ ] Added/updated relevant unit/integration/concurrency/architecture tests
- [ ] Ran or reviewed `./mvnw -B -ntp verify`
- [ ] Verified the Docker/Keycloak smoke workflow when business endpoints changed
- [ ] Checked Flyway migration compatibility and existing database upgrade path
- [ ] Updated OpenAPI and docs when contract changes
- [ ] Reviewed new dependency risk, image findings and SBOM evidence
- [ ] Recorded the why/trade-offs in an ADR for nontrivial architecture decisions

## Safety and limits

Describe whether there is data migration, potential irreversible effects, local demo secrets, release impact or an unresolved production risk. Do not assert production readiness solely because CI passes.
